Provides a resource to create a TKE kubernetes global maintenance window and exclusion

> **NOTE:** If the `targetRegions` is `*`, global maintenance window with all region cannot be deleted

## Import



TKE kubernetes global maintenance window and exclusion can be imported using the id, e.g.

```sh
$ pulumi import tencentcloud:Kubernetes/globalMaintenanceWindowAndExclusion:GlobalMaintenanceWindowAndExclusion example 55
```



To learn more about importing existing cloud resources, see [Importing resources](/docs/using-pulumi/adopting-pulumi/import/).
